requires.name: node
requires.check: [ "$(MISE_EXEC_AUTO_INSTALL=0 mise exec node@26.13.0 -- node -e 'require("node:sqlite"); process.stdout.write(process.version)' 2>/dev/null)" = v26.13.0 ]

requires.name: electron
requires.check: MISE_EXEC_AUTO_INSTALL=0 mise exec -- pnpm --filter @fabrica/ui --filter @fabrica/desktop exec node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const dir = path.dirname(require.resolve('electron/package.json')); const file = path.join(dir, 'path.txt'); process.exit(fs.existsSync(file) && fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'dist', fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))) ? 0 : 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1

requires.name: xvfb-linux
requires.manual: Install Xvfb (Ubuntu: sudo apt-get install xvfb): on a machine without a display, scripts/check-fast.sh runs its suites under xvfb-run for the UI look test's Electron window.

requires.name: git-linux
requires.manual: Install git 2.38 or later (Ubuntu 22.04's git 2.34 is too old: use the git-core PPA, ppa:git-core/ppa).

requires.name: shellcheck
requires.check: MISE_EXEC_AUTO_INSTALL=0 mise exec aqua:koalaman/shellcheck@0.11.0 -- shellcheck --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'version: 0.11.0'
